text: DSH Account Balance Badge 是面向 DSH Web 的侧栏余额组件，在左侧栏显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额和赠送余额。它通过 DSH 的 account remote 获取余额，并在侧栏 footer 注册余额行；用户可点击刷新，也会在窗口聚焦及页面可见时每 60 秒刷新。充值按钮在 Desktop 中打开应用内官方充值页，在普通 Web 中打开新标签页。适合希望随时查看 DeepSeek 账户余额并快速进入充值页的 DSH 用户；需要登录 DeepSeek 账户，不需要单独配置 API Key。

DSH Account Balance Badge shows signed-in DeepSeek wallet balances in the DSH Web sidebar. It reads through DSH’s account remote and refreshes on click, focus, or every 60 seconds while visible. A top-up button opens the official page in the Desktop app or browser. No separate API key is required.
想在 DSH 侧边栏随时看到 DeepSeek 账户还剩多少余额。
能不能在 DSH 里快速打开 DeepSeek 充值页面？
I want my DeepSeek balance visible in the DSH sidebar and easy to refresh.
DSH Account Balance Badge 的功能「侧栏余额」：在左侧栏 footer 显示账户钱包余额和正数赠送余额；组件加载时读取，点击、窗口重新聚焦或页面可见时每 60 秒刷新。
DSH Account Balance Badge 的功能「充值入口」：余额行旁提供 Top up 按钮；Desktop 在应用内打开充值页，普通 Web 则打开新标签页，返回后重新读取余额。
DSH Account Balance Badge 通过 DSH account remote 读取已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额，并打开 platform.deepseek.com 官方充值页；不需单独配置 API Key。

dsh-account-balance-badge README · DSH Account Balance Badge： A persistent [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web UI plugin that keeps the signed-in DeepSeek account balance visible in the **left sidebar**, with a one-click in-app recharge action that opens DeepSeek's official top-up page without leaving the app. [中文说明](README.zh.md)

dsh-account-balance-badge README · Features：- **Always visible, on the left**: a full-width balance row in the sidebar footer, directly above
  Settings (below the shipped Cordis plugins row), so it stays visible across home, settings, and
  conversation views instead of hiding inside the Account settings page.
- **Recharge and bonus wallets**: shows every wallet returned by the account service with the
  Platform's currency formatting (CNY `¥`, USD `$`; two decimals with digit grouping; sub-cent
  amounts shown as `<¥0.01`). Positive bonus credit is appended as a small `Bonus ¥x.xx` note.
- **Recharge inside the app**: a compact `Top up` (充值) button beside the amount opens the official
  DeepSeek top-up page as an in-app native Platform view on the Desktop app, with a
  "Back to DeepSeek Harness" bar; returning re-reads the balance. A plain Web UI opens the same page
  in a new tab instead. The button is disabled while signed out.
- **Sensible refresh**: reads once on mount, refreshes every 60 seconds while the page is visible,
  on window focus, when the row is clicked, and after returning from the top-up page. Reads are
  in-flight deduplicated.
- **Localized and theme-aware**:

dsh-account-balance-badge README · Requirements：- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` (verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2).
- A profile-managed DSH installation (the Desktop app, or `dsh web` launched with a profile), with
  the shipped Web UI plugins enabled (the sidebar, locale, and account controller are part of the
  standard Web app).
- A signed-in DeepSeek account for amounts; a signed-out installation shows the localized
  "signed out" state instead of an amount and keeps the recharge action disabled.
- In-app recharge needs the **Desktop app**: it uses the preload-owned `dshPlatform` bridge to host
  the official page in a native view. A plain browser build opens the deployment's top-up URL in a
  new tab instead.

dsh-account-balance-badge README · From the DSH Web UI (recommended)：1. In DSH, select **Plugins** in the left sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** (or the arrow → **Install a third-party plugin**).
3. Enter one of:
   - a Git address: `github:NebulaXIX/dsh-account-balance-badge` (tracks `main`), or
     `github:NebulaXIX/dsh-account-balance-badge#v0.2.0` to pin the release
   - the release tarball: the absolute path to `dsh-account-balance-badge-0.2.0.tgz`
   - an absolute path to a local checkout
4. Click **Install**.
5. When installation finishes, choose **Enable now**. A profile with HMR recomposes immediately;
   otherwise restart DeepSeek Harness. The balance row appears in the left sidebar footer.

dsh-account-balance-badge README · Usage：- The row shows a wallet icon, the localized label, and the current balance(s).
- Click the row to refresh; it also refreshes when the window regains focus and every 60 seconds
  while the page is visible.
- Click **Top up** (充值) beside the amount to recharge: on the Desktop app the official DeepSeek
  top-up page opens inside the application window under a "Back to DeepSeek Harness" bar, and
  returning re-reads the balance; in a plain Web UI the same page opens in a new tab.
- Loading, signed-out, and failed-but-retryable states are shown in place; the row never fabricates
  a zero balance. If the page fails to load, the return bar stays available with a localized error
  and a Retry action; Escape also returns.
- The row expands to a full-width 42 px row when the sidebar is wide and becomes a compact 36 px
  icon in the collapsed rail (the accessible name and tooltip carry the amount). On Windows Desktop
  the shipped shell hides the whole sidebar footer while the sidebar is collapsed, so the row is
  hidden there just like the Settings and Cordis rows.

dsh-account-balance-badge README · How it works：| Half | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | Empty bundle half: carries the Loader row only, adds no Host capability, tool, or prompt surface. |
| Client | `client.js` | Registers the row in `sidebar.footer.action` and one page host in `shell.overlay`; reads balances through `ctx.remote.account.getBalance`; asks the Desktop preload bridge (`globalThis.dshPlatform`) to host the top-up page and renders the row, the return bar, and the component-local stylesheet. |
| Loader patch | `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `account-balance-badge` row named after this package. |
| Display metadata | `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`, `icon.svg` | Plugin Manager title, description, and icon. |

dsh-account-balance-badge README · How it works：The balance read is a Host-to-Platform query performed by the account service; the browser only
receives wallet amounts (currency and decimal strings). The recharge page is not rendered by this
plugin at all: the Desktop owns the native `WebContentsView` and its Platform credentials, while the
plugin only contributes the 48 px return bar and reports the measured viewport rectangle
(`open` / `setBounds` / `close` on the preload bridge).

dsh-account-balance-badge README · Development：```bash
git clone https://github.com/NebulaXIX/dsh-account-balance-badge.git
cd dsh-account-balance-badge
npm test          # zero-dependency manifest/structure checks
```

Install your checkout as a bundle with the local-path option in the Plugins dialog (or
`dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/checkout`). The Web UI picks up client changes through
HMR while the bundle is link-installed; a full page refresh loads the latest bundle if HMR is
unavailable.

dsh-account-balance-badge README · Refresh interval：The background refresh cadence is the `REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS` constant at the top of
`client.js` (default `60000` ms). Change it in a local checkout if you prefer another cadence; the
row still refreshes on click and on window focus.

dsh-account-balance-badge README · Publishing this plugin (maintainers)：1. Bump `version` in `package.json` and add an entry to `CHANGELOG.md`.
2. Run `npm test` (`scripts/check.mjs`, zero dependencies) and `npm pack --dry-run`; the tarball must
   contain `index.js`, `client.js`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `icon.svg`, `locale/en.json`, and
   `locale/zh.json` (plus README/LICENSE/CHANGELOG, which npm always includes; `scripts/`,
   `docs/`, and `.github/` are intentionally not shipped).
3. Commit on a `dev/<task>` branch, run `npm test` again, then merge into `main`.
4. Tag and push:
   `git tag v<version> && git push origin main --tags`.
5. Pack and publish the release with the tarball attached:
   `npm pack --pack-destination dist` then
   `gh release create v<version> dist/dsh-account-balance-badge-<version>.tgz --title "v<version>" --notes-file <notes>`.
6. Optional npm publication (makes the package-name install route work):
   `npm publish --access public` — the package name `dsh-account-balance-badge` is currently free on
   the registry, but publishing needs a logged-in npm account.
